title: Building a molecular test for an emerging disease in a global pandemic
text:
Six months before the COVID-19 pandemic took the world by storm, I had the great fortune of a trio of entrepreneurs taking an interest in some unique diagnostic patents I had generated earlier in my career while at Monolythix. We had a shared vision to make diagnostics accessible to everyone and everywhere then built up a company, BiologyWorks, together with some of his friends. Suddenly, I found myself helping to get a business plan together, conducting market analysis, and convince others that we are worth their investment. We were successful in gaining funding and suddenly the pandemic took off but that was only the beginning. A whole journey ensued after in bringing up a laboratory, forming a team, developing a product, and then taking it to market.

title: Consulting

Diagnostics Technical Services
Drawing my product development experience from over 10 years in diagnostics, I offer a wide array of technical services designed to cater to a broad spectrum of needs. Whether you’re an academic or in the industry, here’s a detailed list of the services I provide:

Meta-analysis
In-vitro diagnostics (qPCR, qLAMP, CRISPR, and NGS) design
Regulatory strategy and compliance (US FDA, IVDR, and ISO13485)
Polymer chemistry (porous monoliths, precision functionalization, and molecular capture systems)
Design of experiments formulation and analysis
Probabilistic system risk assessment modeling
Python programming
Computationally reproducible and self-contained manuscripts

title: Consulting
text:
Data Visualization Services
I can help you prepare high-quality data visualizations for academic publications, websites, slideshows, etc. There are two types of data visualizations that I provide: stand-alone diagrams and computationally reproducible figures.
To ensure that your specific needs are met, you can either send me a detailed description of the desired diagram via email with the following information:

What kind of figure do you need?
When do you realistically need to have it ready by?
Do you have all the information needed to produce the figure?
Could you provide an example of a figure you are trying to emulate?

Then we can set up a free 20-minute virtual meeting to discuss the details further.

Diagrams
Stand-alone diagrams are used as visual representations of a scientific concept. Each diagram I produce will be made available as a high-resolution PNG, JPEG, and SVG file. For your convenience I included an example of my work below .

title: Ivan D. Rueda
text:
I’m Ivan, a biotechnology professional and MS/MBA graduate student at The Johns Hopkins University, where I also serve as a Center for Innovative Leadership Fellow. By training I’m a molecular biologist, but over the past 10+ years I’ve worn many hats in the diagnostics industry as an assay developer, polymer chemist, data scientist, and technical product leader.
My career journey has taken me from R&D bench work developing novel polymer chemistry for liquid biopsy analysis at Monolythix, to leading cross-functional teams through FDA regulatory pathways at companies like BiologyWorks and Detect. Along the way, I’ve helped develop molecular diagnostic platforms achieving 99.1% accuracy, contributed to securing funding for COVID-19 testing solutions, and earned two patents in diagnostic technologies. What drives me is finding the hidden connections that move ideas forward and translating complex user needs into product specifications while bridging technical capabilities with business requirements.
I’m passionate about democratizing precision diagnostics and making complex testing more accessible and patient-centered. I currently live in Chicago with my girlfriend and our corgi, and I’m a sometime musician when I’m not diving into healthcare economics or product strategy.
 Please visit LinkedIn for more information about my professional experience.

Research Interests

Diagnostics: Nucleic acid amplification tests, non-invasive nucleic acid tests, immunochemical, and volatile organic compound biomarkers for infectious disease and precision diagnostics.
Computational Biology & Data Science: Computatutational dynamics of complex systems, nucleic acid folding and protein interaction modeling, and algorithmic pattern recognition.
Functionalized Biomaterials: Bio-degradable self-wicking polymers, multi-layer systems, and surface modifications for biosensing.
